coverage.requirement: Establish the workshop geography before changing viewpoint.
Show the reverse view without mirroring the room's world geometry.

frames.purpose: Front geography anchor; this metadata is not image text.

spec.intent: One graphite storyboard frame establishes a small empty mechanical workshop with a closed east-wall door.

scene.summary: A rectangular workshop has one window on the north wall, one dark-red wheel mounted on the west wall, a closed plain metal door on the east wall, and one central wooden table aligned north to south.
scene.setting: Camera at the south side faces north. The north window is ahead, west-wall wheel is screen-left, and east-wall door is screen-right.

composition.framing: the central table separates the wheel and closed door; one continuous calm floor area remains foreground

lighting.summary: One soft daylight source enters from the north window and follows the room's fixed geography.

visual_traits: a restrained dark-red accent on the wheel only

must_preserve: one window on the north wall
one wheel on the west wall
closed door on the east wall
one central table aligned north to south

frames.purpose: Reverse-view anchor; the south wall is an explicit original design, not a claim about an unseen reference.

spec.intent: One graphite storyboard frame shows the same workshop from the north side facing south; its world layout stays fixed.

scene.summary: The rectangular workshop has a single north-wall window behind the camera, the dark-red wheel on the west wall, the closed plain metal door on the east wall, and the central wooden table aligned north to south. The newly visible south wall is a plain plaster wall.
scene.setting: Camera near the north wall faces south. The east-wall door is screen-left, the west-wall wheel is screen-right, and the plain south wall is ahead. The north window remains behind the camera.

composition.framing: the opposite end of the table occupies the foreground; wheel and closed door remain readable on their correct walls

lighting.summary: The same soft north-window daylight now enters from behind the camera, with contact shadows consistent with the unchanged room.

visual_traits: a restrained dark-red accent on the wheel only

must_preserve: north-window world position behind this camera
west-wall wheel and east-wall closed door
one central table aligned north to south
graphite medium and selective detail hierarchy

spec.intent: One close graphite storyboard frame clearly shows a retracted sliding door bolt; the door remains closed.

scene.summary: A plain east-wall metal workshop door remains flush with its frame. Its horizontal brushed-steel bolt is fully retracted into its housing, leaving a visible gap before the keeper.
scene.setting: Only the latch, a small door-surface region, and the keeper are in frame.

composition.camera_angle: near frontal with a slight side offset
composition.framing: the retracted bolt and empty keeper form the single primary read; calm door surface surrounds them

lighting.summary: Soft north-window light creates local contact shadows under the housing and a narrow material-specific highlight on the bolt.

visual_traits: precise focal edges on the gap

must_preserve: bolt is fully retracted and separated from keeper
